summary: Keep unrelated claim backlogs out of the attention delta fold budget

replay.detail: Claims and replay ordering are unchanged. The existing unread-kind dependency contract is applied before the bounded delta materializes.

schema.detail: No persisted schema, index, checkpoint or namespace changes.

rules.detail: Attention eligibility, complete-cut publication and projection freshness samples retain their existing contracts. Future acceptance deadlines include unread claims as before.

compatibility.detail: More than 10000 unrelated telemetry, message or other permanently unread claims no longer force a full attention refold. The 10000-claim limit still applies to potentially relevant claims; relevant changes after an unrelated backlog remain visible.

downtime.detail: No migration or coordinated downtime; the new delta selection takes effect when the daemon binary is restarted normally.

manual.detail: No configuration or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: A binary rollback requires no data conversion. Readers continue to receive complete publications with their own source cuts.
